answer: In this PoA design, an agent’s identity is bound to a remotely attested enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE), so a copied VM cannot simply mint an equivalent trusted identity: the claimant must prove execution on genuine attested hardware. This raises Sybil costs from cheap software duplication toward acquiring physical silicon and passing attestation. The bridge verifies evidence; a cipher protects its transport, while “sonnet” names no security primitive.
